observed: On the central host itself (no tunnel, no docker exec), the daemon's unauthenticated local /live endpoint answers in about 1 ms except once a minute, when it takes 15-17 s (20:44:12Z 15.2 s, 20:45:14Z 16.1 s, 20:46:14Z 16.9 s; 51 other samples at 2 s cadence were fast). /live does no work, so the daemon's event loop is blocked.
The daemon logs the fleet-supervisor tick's completion (jev_shadow_observation) at 20:43:12Z, 20:44:13Z, 20:45:14Z, 20:46:14Z and 20:47:14Z, which is where each stall ends.

Through the secondary's tunnel, the central scheduler status call takes 8.2-18.0 s at the same point of every minute and about 85 ms otherwise (sampled every 10 s, 20:28-20:43Z); unauthenticated requests to the Mission Control app stay fast throughout.

The secondary's once-a-minute health report fails with CENTRAL_SCHEDULER_UNREACHABLE (10 s client timeout) in 2-3 minute runs about every 15 minutes: since 18:27Z on 2026-09-26, and also on 2026-09-25 00:05-06:18Z before the browser restart. The 15-minute rhythm is the health timer drifting through the once-a-minute stall; runs whose first central call lands early in a stall time out.
centralStall.cause: daemon/server.ts starts the fleet supervisor with setInterval(MISSION_CONTROL_FLEET_SUPERVISOR_POLL_MS, default 60 s). FleetSupervisorRuntime.tick (lib/fleet-supervisor.ts) reads the worker's events and calls store.verifyChain(), a verification of the whole event chain, synchronously for each due watch. Its cost grows with the event history. The chain verification is the most likely blocking step; a profile of one tick would confirm it.
centralStall.impactOnRelay: The relay's central-scheduler client times out after 10 s (MC_RELAY_SUBMISSION_AUTHORITY_TIMEOUT_MS default). A send makes several central calls (admission, validation, boundary, binding, outcome). A call that starts early in a stall times out. For an in-band request, a failure without a confirmed pre-boundary abort is recorded as AMBIGUOUS_AFTER_RESTART, and automatic replay is then prohibited.

mitigation.change: A systemd drop-in setting MC_RELAY_SUBMISSION_AUTHORITY_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 for the relay and health units. It is a non-secret setting, and the relay env file is not touched.
mitigation.primary: Installed at about 2026-09-26T20:50Z; the relay there is inactive, so it takes effect only if the primary is ever started.
mitigation.secondary: Not applied. The assistant's attempt (drop-in plus relay restart) was refused by its execution environment, so it is owner-run with a prepared script. The owner was told the command and the tradeoff at 2026-09-26T20:52Z.

centralStall.rootFixProposal: Stop re-verifying the entire chain on every fleet-supervisor tick. For example, verify once per tick instead of once per watch, and verify incrementally from the last verified head, keeping a periodic full verification; or move verification off the request event loop. This needs a Mission Control change and a central redeploy.
